Subject: Clarification on publicity / logo clauses in the order form

Hi Nikhil / Marissa,

Thanks for the redlines. Our legal team has two fast follow questions before we hand this back to procurement:

1) Embargo window — the draft Order Form currently allows a 30-day notice before any press mention. Aurelia typically prefers a 45-day embargo for pilots tied to patient outcomes. Is Redwood willing to agree to 45 days for the pilot period only (first 6 months)?

2) Reference escrow — we'd like a short clause that puts quotes or customer success metrics in escrow until both parties approve final text (to avoid premature publication). Can you point us to where Redwood normally puts escrow language?

3) Logo usage — we need confirmation that logo files will only be used on case-study collateral and the press release, and that any broader marketing use requires separate written consent.

Attached: the current Order Form (clean copy) for reference.

Appreciate a quick read — procurement is hoping to finalize the signature page by 9/24.

Best,

Emma — forwarding proposed redlines inline and attaching the document for your legal team to review. I kept the edits surgical so procurement can sign quickly: see highlights below.

--- Proposed redlines (high level) ---
1) Embargo (Order Form §5.3):
   • Pilot period defined as first six (6) months from Effective Date.
   • For pilot period only, Parties agree to a forty‑five (45) day notice window prior to any public announcement referencing Aurelia’s name, logo, or performance metrics.
   • After the pilot period, the notice window reverts to thirty (30) days unless otherwise agreed in writing.

2) Reference escrow (MSA addendum):
   • Any customer quotes, case study drafts, and performance metrics provided by Aurelia will be held in escrow pending mutual written approval.
   • The escrowed materials may not be used by Redwood in any public-facing materials until both Parties sign-off in writing.
   • If either Party does not approve final text within thirty (30) days of submission, the materials will remain private and may be redacted.

3) Logo usage (Order Form §5.4):
   • Redwood may use Aurelia’s logo solely for the limited purposes of: (a) the press release co‑issued under §5.3, and (b) case study collateral mutually approved in writing.
   • Any additional use (website homepage placement, paid marketing, partner listings) requires written consent from an authorized representative of Aurelia.

4) Evidence & approvals timeline:
   • Draft press release to be circulated 10 business days prior to agreed publication date for final sign-off.
   • If procurement requires a signed order to meet an internal deadline, Redwood will provide an interim signature with a carveout stating final publicity language will be agreed post-signature within 10 business days.

I attached two files: a tracked-redline Word of the Order Form and a short publicity summary CSV that maps allowed vs. prohibited uses for quick procurement review. If that looks ok, Ben and I can make any final tweaks and then send a DocuSign packet for signature.

Marissa
